events.description: Rumsfeld sends a snowflake memo to Gen. Franks, copied to Gen. Myers, asking whether contractors have been considered to train the Afghan army.
Rumsfeld sent a snowflake memo to Gen. Franks, copying Gen. Myers, asking about using contractors to train the Afghan army.

relationships.detail: Rumsfeld directs a query to Franks about using contractors to train the Afghan army.
relationships.quote: Have you thought of using contractors to train the Afghan army?

relationships.detail: Myers is copied on the memo.
Rumsfeld issued the memo as Secretary of Defense; the page bears an OSD document stamp.
Franks was asked whether contractors could be used to train the Afghan army.
relationships.quote: Have you thought of using contractors to train the Afghan army?

key_claims: On 23 April 2002 Rumsfeld asked Gen. Franks whether private contractors could be used to train the Afghan army.
